NOTES
a Third-angle projection, mm, 1:1. (?) marks an unconfirmed value - measure it before you commit geometry.
b THE FORM IS DRIVEN BY THE CRESCENT. The shell arc R101 and the LED crescent R89 are CONCENTRIC about
(101, 80.9), giving a constant 12 mm rim - 8.4 of it on the front plate. The arc radius is W/2, so
the rim is set by W alone: rim = W/2 - 89. Widen the body and the rim widens with it.
c The crown is a CYLINDER, not a sphere - it curves in FRONT only. SIDE is a flat-topped box with an R4 edge break.
d W AND H ARE BOTH DERIVED, NOT CHOSEN. Bottom-up: floor 4 | tray 22.4-50.3 and speakers 11.3-61.4 side by side |
mic array 64.3-76.3 spanning above them | crescent from 80.9. W is then set by the SPEAKER BODY: it has to fit
between the plate edge and the 86.4 tray, so W = 2 x (edge + clr + 45 + clr + half-tray) = 202.
e >>> WIDENING ALSO HEIGHTENS. The arc radius IS W/2, so H = W/2 + 80.9 = 155.7. Every +2 mm of width buys +1 mm of height.
The 110 array is WIDER than the 86.4 tray, so it cannot sit between the speakers - it spans above the whole cluster.
That is the cheaper arrangement: outboard would need W = 220 and a 30 mm rim; above gives W = 202 and a 12 mm rim for 3.5 mm more height.
f Speakers are Seeed Mono Enclosed 4R 5W: a SEALED BOX 45 x 50 x 22, not a bare cone. They clear the tray by 4.2 mm and
the crescent by 13.2 mm and the mic array by 3 mm. A wider body grows W and H together.
g UPS 3S BOARD STANDS VERTICALLY. It is a 60 x 93 board and 93 will not lie down in a 59 interior, so the
whole board stands against the rear wall, 24 deep (?). That also puts its 12.6 V barrel jack on the wall that has the cutout.
h Clock zone eats 13.5 of the 64 depth (plate 4 + tray 9.5); ReSpeaker Flex + XIAO sit in the remaining 24 mm.
i Charge input is a DC BARREL JACK on the Waveshare UPS 3S board - not USB-C. The only USB-C on the build is the XIAO's own
flashing port, which is internal and needs disassembly to reach (HARDWARE.md). Set the jack height off the as-built board.
j Knob is a full pebble: Ø34 at its widest, cut to a Ø28 flat where it meets a Ø30 boss on the crown.
Blind Ø6 bore x 15 with a 4.5 D-flat. The encoder board mounts to a rib under the ridge.
k ToF sits on the crown beside the knob, board turned LONGWISE front-to-back so its 17.8 edge clears the 25.4 encoder
board by 1.5 mm. Pinhole lands 6.1 mm right of the knob's widest point. Confirm where the chip sits on YOUR breakout -
the drawing assumes it is centred on the board.
l Front plate seats into a rebate in the dome lip (4.5 wide, 3.6 reveal all round).
PARTS
DOME - 'D' extruded along the depth, open front + open bottom, wall 2.5
FRONT MODULE - one part: facade 4, diffuser pocket, diffusion cavity, matrix pocket, speaker nub posts, mic channel
BOTTOM PLATE - chassis: ReSpeaker Flex + UPS 3S, 6x M3, 0.3 clearance/side
MATRIX PAIR - 2x IS31FL3731, held by the front module itself
KNOB - pebble Ø34 x 20 on a Ø28 base flat
LED CARRIER - 2.5 plate, 48 px in 6 cut segments, 6x M2.5 into the cavity wall
SOUND MACHINE - ENCLOSURE SHELL
dome / front module / bottom plate
PROJECTION third angle
UNITS mm SCALE 1:1
